function firePlayerBullet() {
    if (!state.player.alive) return;
    state.playerBullets.push({
        x: state.player.x,
        y: state.player.y - state.player.height/2,
        width: 2 * 2,
        height: 8 * 2,
        speed: 12,
        color: COLORS.bullet
    });
    // Sound placeholder
}

function fireEnemyBullet() {
    // Find bottom-most enemy in a random column
    const cols = {};
    state.enemies.forEach(e => {
        if (!e.alive) return;
        const col = Math.round(e.x / 50); // Approx grid col
        if (!cols[col] || e.y > cols[col].y) cols[col] = e;
    });
    const candidates = Object.values(cols);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return;
    const shooter = candidates[randInt(0, candidates.length - 1)];
    
    state.enemyBullets.push({
        x: shooter.x,
        y: shooter.y + shooter.height/2,
        width: 3 * 2,
        height: 8 * 2,
        speed: 5 + state.level * 0.5,
        color: COLORS.enemyBullet
    });
}

function checkCollisions() {
    // Player Bullets vs Enemies
    for (let i = state.playerBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const b = state.playerBullets[i];
        let hit = false;
        for (let j = state.enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            const e = state.enemies[j];
            if (!e.alive) continue;
            if (rectCollision(b, e)) {
                e.alive = false;
                state.score += e.points;
                createExplosion(e.x, e.y, e.color);
                hit = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (hit) {
            state.playerBullets.splice(i, 1);
            updateUI();
            continue;
        }
        // Player Bullet vs UFO
        if (state.ufo && rectCollision(b, state.ufo)) {
            state.score += state.ufo.points;
            createExplosion(state.ufo.x, state.ufo.y, state.ufo.color, true);
            state.ufo = null;
            state.ufoTimer = rand(15, 30) * 1000;
            state.playerBullets.splice(i, 1);
            updateUI();
        }
        // Player Bullet vs Enemy Bullets
        for (let k = state.enemyBullets.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            const eb = state.enemyBullets[k];
            if (rectCollision(b, eb)) {
                createExplosion(b.x, b.y, COLORS.bullet, false, 5);
                state.playerBullets.splice(i, 1);
                state.enemyBullets.splice(k, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
        // Player Bullet vs Barriers
        for (let k = state.barriers.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            const bar = state.barriers[k];
            if (checkBarrierCollision(bar, b)) {
                state.playerBullets.splice(i, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Enemy Bullets vs Player
    if (state.player.alive && state.player.invincible <= 0) {
        for (let i = state.enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const b = state.enemyBullets[i];
            if (rectCollision(b, state.player)) {
                state.enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
                playerHit();
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Enemy Bullets vs Barriers
    for (let i = state.enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const b = state.enemyBullets[i];
        for (let k = state.barriers.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            if (checkBarrierCollision(state.barriers[k], b)) {
                state.enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Enemies vs Barriers (Destruction on contact)
    state.barriers.forEach(bar => {
        state.enemies.forEach(e => {
            if (!e.alive) return;
            if (e.y + e.height/2 > bar.y - bar.height/2) {
                // Enemy touching barrier, destroy overlapping blocks
                const relX = (e.x - bar.x) / (bar.blockSize);
                const relY = (e.y - bar.y) / (bar.blockSize);
                // Simplified: destroy blocks near enemy center
                bar.blocks.forEach(block => {
                    const bx = bar.x + (block.x - 1.5) * bar.blockSize;
                    const by = bar.y + (block.y - 0.5) * bar.blockSize;
                    if (Math.abs(e.x - bx) < bar.blockSize * 2 && Math.abs(e.y - by) < bar.blockSize * 2) {
                        block.health = 0;
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    });
}

function rectCollision(a, b) {
    return a.x - a.width/2 < b.x + b.width/2 &&
           a.x + a.width/2 > b.x - b.width/2 &&
           a.y - a.height/2 < b.y + b.height/2 &&
           a.y + a.height/2 > b.y - b.height/2;
}

function checkBarrierCollision(bar, bullet) {
    // Bullet center relative to barrier top-left
    const relX = bullet.x - (bar.x - bar.width/2);
    const relY = bullet.y - (bar.y - bar.height/2);
    
    if (relX < 0 || relX > bar.width || relY < 0 || relY > bar.height) return false;
    
    // Which block?
    const blockX = Math.floor(relX / bar.blockSize);
    const blockY = Math.floor(relY / bar.blockSize);
    
    if (blockX < 0 || blockX >= 3 || blockY < 0 || blockY >= 2) return false;
    
    const block = bar.blocks[blockY * 3 + blockX];
    if (block.health > 0) {
        block.health--;
        createExplosion(bullet.x, bullet.y, COLORS.barrier, false, 3);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

function playerHit() {
    state.lives--;
    state.player.invincible = 2000; // 2 seconds
    createExplosion(state.player.x, state.player.y, COLORS.player, true);
    updateUI();
    if (state.lives <= 0) {
        state.player.alive = false;
        gameOver();
    }
}

function createExplosion(x, y, color, big = false, count = 15) {
    const num = big ? count * 2 : count;
    for (let i = 0; i < num; i++) {
        const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
        const speed = rand(1, big ? 6 : 4);
        state.particles.push({
            x: x, y: y,
            vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
            color: color,
            size: rand(1, 3),
            life: rand(300, 600),
            maxLife: 600,
            alpha: 1
        });
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDERING
   ============================================================ */
function render() {
    const ctx = state.ctx;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H);
    
    // Stars
    renderStars();
    
    // Barriers
    renderBarriers();
    
    // Enemies
    renderEnemies();
    
    // UFO
    if (state.ufo) renderSprite(state.ufo, state.ufo.sprite, state.ufo.color);
    
    // Player
    if (state.player.alive) {
        if (state.player.invincible <= 0 || Math.floor(state.player.invincible / 100) % 2 === 0) {
            renderSprite(state.player, state.player.sprite, state.player.color, state.player.detailColor);
        }
    }
    
    // Bullets
    renderBullets(state.playerBullets, COLORS.bullet, SPRITES.bullet);
    renderBullets(state.enemyBullets, COLORS.enemyBullet, SPRITES.enemyBullet);
    
    // Particles
    renderParticles();
    
    // Pause Overlay Text (Rendered via HTML, but we can draw "PAUSED" on canvas if needed)
}

function renderStars() {
    const ctx = state.ctx;
    state.stars.forEach(s => {
        const alpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(s.twinkle) * 0.5;
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function renderSprite(entity, spriteData, primaryColor, secondaryColor = null) {
    const ctx = state.ctx;
    const scale = 2; // Hardcoded scale factor used in entity creation
    const w = spriteData[0].length;
    const h = spriteData.length;
    
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(entity.x, entity.y);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);
    
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            const val = spriteData[y][x];
            if (val === 0) continue;
            ctx.fillStyle = val === 2 && secondaryColor ? secondaryColor : primaryColor;
            ctx.fillRect(x - w/2, y - h/2, 1, 1);
        }
    }
    ctx.restore();
}

function renderBullets(bullets, color, spriteData) {
    const ctx = state.ctx;
    const scale = 2;
    const w = spriteData[0].length;
    const h = spriteData.length;
    
    bullets.forEach(b => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
        ctx.scale(scale, scale);
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
            for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                if (spriteData[y][x]) {
                    ctx.fillRect(x - w/2, y - h/2, 1, 1);
                }
            }
        }
        ctx.restore();
    });
}

function renderBarriers() {
    const ctx = state.ctx;
    const scale = 2;
    const sprite = SPRITES.barrier;
    const sw = sprite[0].length;
    const sh = sprite.length;
    
    state.barriers.forEach(bar => {
        // Draw sprite base
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(bar.x, bar.y);
        ctx.scale(scale, scale);
        
        // We need to mask the sprite based on block health
        // Each block is 4x4 logic pixels = 8x8 scaled pixels.
        // Sprite is 12x8 pixels (3 blocks wide, 2 blocks high).
        // Block 0,0 covers sprite x 0-3, y 0-3. Block 1,0 covers 4-7, 0-3. Block 2,0 covers 8-11, 0-3.
        // Block 0,1 covers 0-3, 4-7. etc.
        
        for (let by = 0; by < 2; by++) {
            for (let bx = 0; bx < 3; bx++) {
                const block = bar.blocks[by * 3 + bx];
                if (block.health <= 0) continue;
                
                const sx = bx * 4;
                const sy = by * 4;
                const blockW = 4;
                const blockH = 4;
                
                // Damage color shift
                const healthRatio = block.health / 4;
                const r = Math.round(0 * healthRatio + 0 * (1-healthRatio)); // Green stays green
                const g = Math.round(255 * healthRatio + 136 * (1-healthRatio)); // Bright -> Dim
                const b = Math.round(136 * healthRatio + 68 * (1-healthRatio));
                const drawColor = `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
                
                ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
                for (let y = 0; y < blockH; y++) {
                    for (let x = 0; x < blockW; x++) {
                        if (sprite[sy + y][sx + x]) {
                            ctx.fillRect(sx + x - sw/2, sy + y - sh/2, 1, 1);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ctx.restore();
    });
}

function renderEnemies() {
    state.enemies.forEach(e => {
        if (!e.alive) return;
        const sprite = e.sprites[state.enemyAnimFrame];
        renderSprite(e, sprite, e.color);
    });
}

function renderParticles() {
    const ctx = state.ctx;
    state.particles.forEach(p => {
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size/2, p.y - p.size/2, p.size, p.size);
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

/* ============================================================
   START
   ============================================================ */
window.addEventListener('load', init);
</script>
</body>
</html>
